goal: Prevent expired and revoked keys from satisfying the binary verification quorum by default
Allow users to optionally permit expired keys when verifying historical releases
agreement: Nonblocking objection that excluding expired keys breaks verifying older releases (willcl-ark)
Author added an opt-in flag suggested by sedited and supported by willcl-ark to resolve it

categories.name: tools
why: P1 because it fixes a security flaw in binary verification disclosed by the Red Team
Verification could previously succeed entirely on revoked or expired signatures without active keys
